titles.en: Stele of Duke Yugong, Southern Song rubbing

productionDate.note: The museum identifies the impression as Southern Song by the undamaged 历 and 高 characters. It gives no year.

dimensions.note: The museum gives the size of one leaf; the album's page count is not stated in the fields read.

relationships.note: The museum's entry states that the stone from which this impression was taken is now in 昭陵博物馆.

currentCollection.note: The museum catalogues the album under 新00045747. Its entry quotes the 欧斋藏碑帖目录, which records a Song rubbing bought for three thousand yuan, but does not say when the museum acquired this album.
currentCollection.noteZh: 馆方著录藏品号 新00045747。条目引《欧斋藏碑帖目录》所记宋拓本购价三千元，但未记本册入藏年份。

review.note: Draft object record from the Palace Museum entry read on 2026-11-23. The Southern Song dating rests on the museum's character-damage test; no plate was compared and the album was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的故宫页面整理。南宋之定依据馆方所记字损特征；未比看图版，未核对原册。

notes: The album is a cut-and-mounted edition: the museum calls it a 剪裱装册, so the leaf size is not the stone's.
The museum's purchased-for figure belongs to the 欧斋 catalogue it quotes, not necessarily to this album's own acquisition.
notesZh: 此册为剪裱装，故每页尺寸非石面尺寸。
馆方所引购价出自《欧斋藏碑帖目录》，未必即本册的入藏记录。
